topics.description: The federal government has deferred $91 million in Minnesota Medicaid funding due to fraud vulnerabilities. This is a significant development in the ongoing investigation into Medicaid funding in Minnesota.
topics.reason: New developments in Medicaid funding investigation

topics.description: The FBI has raided and is investigating Feeding Our Future, a nonprofit accused of fraud. This is a significant development in the ongoing investigation into nonprofit organizations in Minnesota.
topics.reason: New developments in Feeding Our Future investigation
